name: Citizenship by Birth or Descent

qualifying_event.description: Citizenship is conferred automatically by birth in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, or is available on registration to a person born abroad with a Vincentian parent or (since a 2023 amendment) grandparent.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; proof of the parent's or grandparent's Vincentian citizenship by birth or registration.

requirement_groups.name: Born in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines

requirements.blocker_text: Automatic citizenship for anyone born within Saint Vincent and the Grenadines territory.

requirement_groups.name: Born abroad to a Vincentian parent

requirements.blocker_text: At least one parent must have been born in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.

requirement_groups.name: Born abroad to a parent or grandparent who was a citizen (2023 amendment)

requirements.blocker_text: Following a 2023 amendment to Section 9 of the Citizenship Act, a person born outside Saint Vincent and the Grenadines with a parent OR grandparent who was a citizen (whether by birth or registration) may be considered for registration, without needing to establish physical residency or go through naturalisation.
Applicant must be of good character.

evidence_required.document: Parent's or grandparent's birth certificate/proof of Vincentian citizenship
Citizenship Certificate (required before passport application, second-generation cases)
Application fee EC$150 + registration fee EC$1,500-$2,200 (waived for 1 year from the 2023 amendment's enactment for second-generation applicants)

sources.title: St Vincent Times -- Understanding Citizenship, Eligibility for St Vincent Passport: automatic citizenship for those born in the territory; first-generation descent for a child born abroad to a Vincentian-born parent

St Vincent Times -- Citizenship Amendment Bill 2023 Passed by St Vincent's Parliament: quotes the amended Section 9 permitting registration of a person born abroad with a parent OR grandparent who was a citizen, bypassing naturalisation's residence requirement, with a 1-year fee waiver for these applicants

Prime Minister's Office, Government of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines -- Citizenship: confirms the general application fee (EC$150) and registration fee (EC$1,500-$2,200) applicable across citizenship applications, though it does not itself break out the descent-specific grounds
